summary: No new repository code changes were required in this iteration; the work was verification-focused against the already patched CI/bootstrap and browse-regression slice. I cleaned up stale overlapping `vite build` / preview processes, reran a fresh build from an empty output tree, and narrowed the local blocker more precisely: the clean `npm run build` is still exiting before the client/output contract finishes, leaving only `.svelte-kit/output/server` plus `manifest-full.js` and never materializing `build/`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, or `manifest.js`. That explains why the earlier targeted Playwright browse rerun fell over at preview startup with `[500] GET / TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'imports')`: the preview server was reading an incomplete artifact set rather than a confirmed-good full build. So the repo-side CI/bootstrap fixes from the prior iteration still stand, but the final local TEST-G3 / TEST-G4 verification is now gated on getting one fully successful clean build instead of debugging the browser spec in isolation.
remaining_work: Debug and fix the current clean `npm run build` failure so the full preview artifact contract is produced again: `build/`, `.svelte-kit/output/client`, `.svelte-kit/output/server`, and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`.

Once a full build succeeds, rerun `CI=1 VITE_API_URL=https://api.example.test VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.test VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap` to confirm the restored bootstrap contract on the final artifact set.

Rerun `CI=1 npx playwright test tests/e2e/tasks-services-regression-browse.spec.ts --project=chromium --project='Mobile Safari' --workers=1 --retries=0 --reporter=line` against the clean built preview and confirm the Mobile Safari browse regression is resolved.
If the targeted browse rerun is green, rerun the remaining Mobile Safari non-visual aggregate and the final Chromium visual bundle to close the local `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence.

Verify the remaining external `CI-G1` GitLab merge-policy requirements (`only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds`, required jobs active for merge requests) using `GITLAB_TOKEN`, `CI_API_V4_URL`, and `CI_PROJECT_ID` or the real GitLab CI environment.
